description: This file contains logic for matching team members based on attribute queries, including functions for evaluating attribute logic, handling fallbacks, performance measurement, and trace integration within a routing form feature.

methods.name: asyncPerf
methods.description: Wraps an async function to measure its execution time.

methods.name: perf
methods.description: Wraps a sync function to measure its execution time.

methods.name: getErrorsFromImmutableTree
methods.description: Extracts validation errors from an ImmutableTree used in query building.

methods.name: getJsonLogic
methods.description: Generates a JSON Logic object from query value and builder config, with warnings for errors.

methods.name: buildTroubleshooterData
methods.description: Creates a troubleshooter data object for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: isFieldTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a string is a field placeholder template.

methods.name: extractFieldIdFromTemplate
methods.description: Extracts the field ID from a field template string.

methods.name: resolveFieldTemplateValue
methods.description: Resolves a field template string to its actual value from form response.

methods.name: extractAttributeRoutingDetails
methods.description: Extracts attribute name/value pairs from a query value for routing purposes.

methods.name: getLogicResultForAllMembers
methods.description: Evaluates attribute logic against all team members concurrently.

methods.name: runAttributeLogic
methods.description: Main function to evaluate attribute logic, with performance and error handling.

methods.name: getAttributesForLogic
methods.description: Fetches attribute data for a given team and organization, optionally filtered by attribute IDs.

methods.name: findTeamMembersMatchingAttributeLogic
methods.description: Main exported function to find team members matching attribute logic with optional fallback and tracing.
